title: FLA import: frame sound IDs not resolved from library (includes suspicious ID 19072)
description:
Loading Magnet.fla logs 4 sound-not-found warnings from flash8-import.ts:622:
- 'frame sound id 16 not found in library; skipping'
- 'frame sound id 19 not found in library; skipping'
- 'frame sound id 19072 not found in library; skipping'
- 'frame sound id 32 not found in library; skipping'

Sound ID 19072 is suspicious — this is far outside the normal range for a 87-item library, suggesting either a corrupt byte read or a misalignment in the sound reference parsing.

## Expected
Sound items referenced by frames should be found in the library. The large ID (19072) likely indicates a parsing bug where the sound ID field is being misread (wrong byte count or offset). Sounds in library: none imported (the FLA has sounds but the parser may not be loading them as SoundItems).
